# Implementation Plan: crews-stop-bg-gate-remove-bypass

*Generated by `/plan-with-ralph` on 2026-06-03. Ready for `/implement-with-ralph --from-plan <job_dir>/plan.md`. Phase 4 multi-model review (Claude rubber-duck + Codex `gpt-5.5` + Copilot) caught 7 issues; all amendments applied below.*

## Overview

Remove the crews v3.2.0 progress + no-bg gate bypass tag entirely. Ship as crews **v3.3.0**. The bypass exists for a structural failure case that doesn't exist: any genuine async-wait pattern is either a follow-up tool call (Stop never fires) or a background subprocess (the detector sees it). There is no "in-process wait" case — the model can't sleep without blocking its synchronous tool-call return, which prevents Stop from firing. If `detector.nonListenerCount === 0` AND `turnKind === 'progress'`, it is ALWAYS a model error: wrong tag, spinning (the original failure mode the gate was created to catch), or finished-and-forgot. A model-controlled bypass self-attests the gate away, defeating its purpose. The v3.2.0 block message at `stop.js:1128` makes the situation actively worse by *teaching* the model the bypass syntax — it becomes the default lazy escape rather than a sometimes-correct override.

v3.3.0 deletes all five bypass surfaces (1 in-band crews-namespaced form + 4 legacy `<options-mode>` / CommonMark forms) without a deprecation cycle. The in-band form is <24 hours old (v3.2.0 shipped 2026-06-03), and the legacy forms had already been re-deprecated in v3.2.0. The operator-controlled `CREWS_PROGRESS_BG_GATE=off` env escape hatch stays — that's a per-machine config knob the operator sets to disable the gate entirely; the model can't set env vars, so it can't self-attest its way past this surface.

The new v3.3.0 message text is **185 characters** (verified by manual count), so all three kind names survive without truncation either way.

### Technical Constraints

- **v3.2.0 flush-race fix must stay intact.** The retry-with-backoff in `lastTurnAssistantText` (text read path) and in `detect-active-bg::detectActiveBg → readEvents` (events read path) is the protection that makes the gate reliable on Copilot. v3.3.0 is purely a bg-gate semantic cleanup; the retry/backoff logic is orthogonal and untouched.

- **Single producer, single consumer.** `bgTask` is set in `mailbox.js::parseTurnReports` and consumed only in `stop.js`'s progress-bg gate block. Removal is safe.

- **Test runner ceiling: under 60s on Windows at default concurrency.** Save test output to a file on first run (`tee /tmp/crews-tests.out`) and grep that file rather than re-running.

- **Version stamp drift hazard.** The plugin version is duplicated across 5 manifest files plus the `tests/version.test.js` assertion. Always use `node plugins/crews/scripts/bump-version.js 3.3.0` — never hand-edit.

## Approach

### Architecture

Single-story, single-commit surgical removal. The bypass detection is small and tightly coupled (one producer, one consumer, multiple test-file edits, doc sections in two files). Splitting it into multiple stories would create awkward intermediate states.

The block-message rewrite is the most important change for the model-facing surface. Old text actively taught the bypass:

> `kind=progress needs active bg work. Use kind=question + reply-to to wait on lead, kind=done/blocked to terminate, or add the background-task attribute to your report tag (e.g. <|report kind="progress" background-task|>) if polling.`

New text (**exactly 185 characters**, survives `sanitizeReason` unmodified):

> `kind=progress requires active background work (open subprocess). Use kind=question + reply-to to wait on the lead, kind=done to complete this turn, or kind=blocked to surface a problem.`

The new message lists exactly three correct kind alternatives. It does not mention any bypass option. `sanitizeReason` does not truncate, so all three kind names survive verbatim.

- Removal of all 5 bypass tag forms from `parseTurnReports` (in-band crews-namespaced) and from `stop.js`'s gate (4 legacy `<options-mode>` / CommonMark forms).
- Removal of the deprecation-warning stderr write and `crews.log` entry.
- Rewriting the block-message text at `stop.js:1128` to the new 185-char v3.3.0 text that lists only the three correct kind alternatives.
- Adding a `STRUCTURAL COMPLETENESS` subsection to `detect-active-bg.js` header comment.
- Flipping or deleting test cases in `tests/progress-bg-gate.test.js` per the verified case-map above.
- Updating ALL old-message reason assertions in `tests/progress-bg-gate.test.js` (Case 1, Case 3, Cases 7-9 skip checks).
- Updating bypass-tag fixtures in `tests/stop-flush-race-retry.test.js` (F.1 + F.6) and `tests/stop-allow-system-notification-boundary.test.js` (Case A.6).

### Out of Scope

- Any change to the v3.2.0 flush-race fix (retry-with-backoff in `lastTurnAssistantText` and `detect-active-bg::readEvents`). This stays intact.
- Any change to the v3.2.0 recoverable-breaker fix.
- Any change to other Stop-hook gates (listener-armed gate, review-required gate, AskUserQuestion intercept, etc.).
- Any change to Claude-engine behavior. The gate is Copilot-only; that scope is unchanged.
- Any change to the operator-controlled `CREWS_PROGRESS_BG_GATE=off` env knob.
- **Pushing the topic branch to toolkit remotes (origin, personal, gim-home).** Per codexu AGENTS.md "Ask before: pushing to remotes," the impl member commits locally; the topic-branch push is operator-confirmed and lead-driven. ## Risk Areas

1. **Block-message length.** The new message text is **185 characters** — verified by manual count (`"kind=progress requires active background work (open subprocess). Use kind=question + reply-to to wait on the lead, kind=done to complete this turn, or kind=blocked to surface a problem."`). `sanitizeReason` does NOT truncate (verified at `hooks/paths.js:86-94` — it only strips ANSI/control chars and normalizes whitespace). The full message will appear in the block decision verbatim.

2. **Case-mapping in the task spec was reversed.** The spec says "Case 4 (was: in-band form passes gate)" but the actual file has Case 4 as the legacy XML form and Case 4-new as the in-band form. The impl member MUST verify by reading the actual file content before editing, NOT by trusting the spec's line numbers or case numbering. This plan's case-map (Implementation Strategy step 4) reflects the verified file contents.

3. **External test file breakages.** `tests/stop-flush-race-retry.test.js` (F.1, F.6) and `tests/stop-allow-system-notification-boundary.test.js` (Case A.6) use the bypass tag in fixtures whose primary purpose is not bypass testing. After v3.3.0, the gate fires and these tests fail. Step 5 + 6 of the Implementation Strategy enumerate the specific fixes.

4. **Hidden old-message references in test assertions.** The reviewer scan found old `'kind=progress needs active bg'` substring assertions in Case 1, Case 3, and skip Cases 7-9 in addition to the obvious Cases 4-6. The impl member MUST grep the file for the old prefix and update every match. Extract a `NEW_REASON_PREFIX` constant to prevent future drift.

5. **AGENTS.md v3.3.0 section placement.** Reverse-chronological convention: v3.3.0 section goes ABOVE the existing v3.1.2 section. (Earlier draft of this plan said "right after v3.1.2" which was wrong; corrected per Codex review F.2.)

6. **CHANGELOG.md v3.2.0 forward-looking statement.** The v3.2.0 entry says "will be removed in crews v4.0.0" — that becomes false when v3.3.0 ships. Step 8 adds a supersession parenthetical to that entry alongside the new v3.3.0 entry.

7. **Test runner concurrency on Windows.** Per AGENTS.md, default concurrency is 10 with a serial denylist. If a v3.3.0 test addition or rewrite pushes a Worker into Windows EPERM territory on temp-file rename, add the file to the denylist.

8. **Multi-repo coordination after impl-side ship.** The impl member ends at "topic branch committed locally with green tests" — pushing to toolkit remotes and bumping the codexu submodule pointer are LEAD responsibilities per codexu AGENTS.md. The impl member's spawn-prompt must NOT include these post-ship steps.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] **AC1:** `parseTurnReports` in `hooks/mailbox.js` no longer sets `out.bgTask`. Cross-grep across `hooks/` shows zero references to `bgTask` as a property and zero functional references to `background-task` / `background-agent` as a bare-token attribute parser. Doc-comment / CHANGELOG / AGENTS.md historical mentions of the strings are allowed. `hooks/detect-active-bg.js:1` keeps its "background-task detector" file-mission comment (the *concept* — what the file detects — survives; only the bypass *parsing* is removed). Test fixtures may retain the bypass strings as input to negative assertions (the strings are now treated as non-special text).
- [ ] **AC2:** `hooks/stop.js`'s progress-bg gate trigger condition is `gateEnabled && isCopilot && isProgress && isMember && !isRetry && !isShuttingDown` (the `!hasBgTag` term is gone). The four-form `text.indexOf` legacy scan AND the deprecation-warning stderr write + crews.log entry block are deleted. The leading comment block is updated to remove bypass enumeration.
- [ ] **AC3:** The block-message string at `stop.js:1128` is exactly `kind=progress requires active background work (open subprocess). Use kind=question + reply-to to wait on the lead, kind=done to complete this turn, or kind=blocked to surface a problem.` (185 characters). After `sanitizeReason` (no truncation in current implementation), the emitted reason names `kind=question`, `kind=done`, AND `kind=blocked` AND does NOT contain `background-task`, `background-agent`, or `options-mode`.
- [ ] **AC4:** `hooks/detect-active-bg.js` header comment includes a new `STRUCTURAL COMPLETENESS` (or equivalent) subsection that states: any real bg work is a subprocess at Stop time; any in-process wait blocks Stop from firing; therefore `nonListenerCount === 0 + kind=progress` is always a model error; if a false-block case appears, extend the detector, don't add a bypass. Line 130's bias-rationale comment is updated to drop "bypass tag" wording.
- [ ] **AC5:** `tests/progress-bg-gate.test.js` Cases 4 / 4-new (renamed 4b) / 5 all assert the gate FIRES on transcripts that contain the previously-bypassed tag forms, AND assert no stderr DEPRECATED text fires, AND assert no `legacy options-mode bypass tag detected` crews.log entry. Cases 5-new / 5b (original) / 5c / 6 are deleted as duplicate / obsolete coverage. A shared `NEW_REASON_PREFIX` constant is used by all reason-text assertions.
- [ ] **AC6:** `tests/progress-bg-gate.test.js` Case 1 is updated: line 316 references the new reason prefix; line 318 `background-task` escape-hint assertion is deleted; three new asserts cover `kind=question`/`kind=done`/`kind=blocked` presence; one assert covers `background-task` absence. Cases 3, 7, 7b, 8, 9 are scanned for old-message references and updated to use `NEW_REASON_PREFIX`.
- [ ] **AC7:** `tests/stop-flush-race-retry.test.js` F.1 and F.6 fixtures updated per Implementation Strategy step 5. F.1 either seeds a real `asyncStart` bg event OR swaps to `kind=done` + armed-listener seed. F.6 drops the bypass attribute (gate's `!isRetry` guard makes this structurally safe but updating is consistent).
- [ ] **AC8:** `tests/stop-allow-system-notification-boundary.test.js` Case A.6 fixture updated per Implementation Strategy step 6: swap `<|report kind="progress" ... background-task|>` → `<|report kind="done" ...|>` (armed-listener seed satisfies terminal-kind discipline).

A new `## v3.3.0 progress-bg gate bypass removal` section is added ABOVE the existing `## v3.1.2 ...` section with the structural argument, removed-surface list, retained env knob (`CREWS_PROGRESS_BG_GATE=off`), "Why no bypass" subsection, edit sites, and migration note.

## Preliminary Story Decomposition

A single story bundle (US-001) carries the entire scope. The change is too tightly coupled to split — a parser-removed-but-consumer-still-references-it intermediate state would be a self-inflicted bug. See `stories-outline.md` for the full story.

## Suggested Decomposition

One cluster, one story, serial execution.

### Cluster: bg-gate-removal

- Stories: US-001
- Phase: 1
- Depends on: None
- File-overlap evidence: shared=[all files listed in Files to Create/Modify]; exclusive=[none — single-story cluster]; risk=low
- `execution_mode` rationale: Single story cluster; serial execution is the only sensible option. Parallelism would force artificial seams that don't correspond to natural change boundaries and would create intermediate states where the parser is removed but the consumer still references the removed field.

Parallel handoff: `/implement-with-ralph --from-plan <plan_job_dir>/plan.md --parallel --suggested-decomposition <plan_job_dir>/suggested-decomposition.json`

Both this task and most impl tasks need only the `ai-developer-toolkit` submodule, not `codex`.
